APPROVE

Replacing the `string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent) || string.Equals(...)` condition with a call to `ParentOrNull` removes one `||` from the method, taking its cognitive complexity from 16 to 15. The helper keeps the same logic and the same break condition, and its nullable typing should build cleanly. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project or run the analyzer.
